Jack Heart, 2026-11-13, settled the group words "fine for now": experiment is the label on runs, taken from the file, with no limits and nothing formal; cohort is a named envelope of limits (parallel, max_usd) that runs are admitted under. Do not rename either. A later launch adding to an existing cohort belongs to EXP-61, not here. scratch/design-train-api.md in this worktree is updated to say so (Names section); the "label word" item is gone from its Open list.
